006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.format;
007
008/**
009 * Enumeration of path format selection options for validation output.
010 * <p>
011 * This enum allows users to control how node paths are formatted in validation
012 * messages and other output. The selection can be explicit (forcing a specific
013 * format) or automatic (selecting based on document format).
014 *
015 * @see IPathFormatter#METAPATH_PATH_FORMATER
016 * @see IPathFormatter#XPATH_PATH_FORMATTER
017 * @see IPathFormatter#JSON_POINTER_PATH_FORMATTER
018 */
019public enum PathFormatSelection {
020  /**
021   * Auto-select the path format based on document format.
022   * <p>
023   * When this option is selected:
024   * <ul>
025   * <li>JSON documents use JSON Pointer format (RFC 6901)</li>
026   * <li>YAML documents use JSON Pointer format (RFC 6901)</li>
027   * <li>XML documents use XPath 3.1 EQName format</li>
028   * </ul>
029   * <p>
030   * This is the default selection when no explicit format is specified.
031   */
032  AUTO,
033
034  /**
035   * Always use Metapath format regardless of document type.
036   * <p>
037   * Produces paths like: {@code /root/assembly[1]/field[1]/@flag}
038   */
039  METAPATH,
040
041  /**
042   * Always use XPath 3.1 EQName format regardless of document type.
043   * <p>
044   * Produces namespace-qualified paths like:
045   * {@code /Q{http://example.com}root/Q{http://example.com}assembly[1]}
046   */
047  XPATH,
048
049  /**
050   * Always use RFC 6901 JSON Pointer format regardless of document type.
051   * <p>
052   * Produces paths like: {@code /root/assemblies/0/id}
053   */
054  JSON_POINTER
055}
